title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.01320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. translated_title: Step-dLLM：面向高效扩散大语言模型推理的自适应步骤感知稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型通过迭代去噪的方式并行生成token，但其双向注意力机制使其无法使用自回归模型中的KV缓存，且每一步都需要重新计算完整的注意力图，导致每步产生平方级的计算开销。现有的dLLM稀疏注意力方法在初始全注意力预热阶段之后构建稀疏掩码，并在其余步骤中复用该掩码，同时将稀疏预算均匀分配到各个注意力头。我们认为这两种做法都忽略了dLLM中注意力的关键结构特性：实验表明，注意力模式在各步骤之间仅在局部保持一致，并在某些转换点发生突变；此外，不同注意力头的注意力质量集中程度差异巨大。为此，我们设计了Step-dLLM，它在去噪轨迹的锚点步骤处周期性地刷新块稀疏掩码，并在每个局部一致的区间内复用该掩码，同时采用……
tldr: 该论文提出Step-dLLM，通过在去噪轨迹的锚点步骤周期性刷新块稀疏掩码、在每个局部一致区间内复用掩码，并根据不同注意力头的集中程度自适应分配稀疏预算，从而高效加速扩散大语言模型的推理。
en_tdlr: Step-dLLM enables efficient diffusion LLM inference by periodically refreshing block-sparse masks at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and adaptively allocating the sparsity budget according to per-head attention concentration.
